commitments.detail: Ensure John receives the table saw by next month.
Ensure Sarah receives the wood lathe by next month.
Ensure the hand tools are stored in the Uncle's locked workshop until further notice.
Ensure the table saw is properly stored and maintained in John's workshop.
Ensure the wood lathe is properly stored and maintained in Sarah's workshop.
Maintain the Uncle's locked workshop as a resource for the family until it is no longer needed.
Ensure John receives the table saw by the end of the next year.
Ensure Sarah receives the wood lathe by the end of the next year.
Maintain access to the uncle's locked workshop for the next year.
To review the distribution plan in one month.
